description: Flat 2D editorial cartoon led by the selected visual references: strict teal, blue, green, mustard, ochre, brown, and off-white palette; sparse backgrounds; playful action with a quiet, slightly lonely undertone.

do_not_copy: white cat or any reference character
reference scene, furniture, props, or pose
text, watermark, signature, logo, or handle
reference_policy.conflict_resolution: When character-reference traits conflict with the selected style, prioritize the selected style. Keep bgoon recognizable through role and action, but allow the style to control palette, shape language, and visual treatment.

linework.quality: Use softly irregular hand-drawn contours; do not copy any depicted character, text, signature, or watermark.

paper_texture: Subtle matte paper grain; keep flat color fields clean and mobile-readable.

palette.rule: Use these colors and restrained lighter or darker tints only. Do not introduce a dominant hue outside this family unless the user explicitly requests it.

background.rule: Use one flat or nearly empty color field. Add only props essential to the beat; do not add decorative furnishings, patterns, or visual clutter.

emotional_tone: Playful, brisk physical comedy balanced with a quiet, slightly lonely undertone.
lighting: flat, readable, and continuous across adjacent panels
composition: mobile-first, one focal action, broad negative space for later speech bubbles, and no incidental detail competing with the subject
